messages:
Marie: Uploading hero image for the Integration Playbook with HelixCloud. Need logo placement + alt text + legal ok. Screenshot includes customer dashboard — is that allowed? Link: https://files.redwood.co/helix-playbook-hero.png (900x450)

Kai: Thanks! Image looks great. Suggest crop to 16:9 center-locked, add 40% dark gradient on the left for white text overlay. Also please send preferred HelixCloud SVG + clearspace rules. :art:

Marie: Got it — I have their partner pack. Which alt text copy are we using? "Developer using HelixCloud with Redwood Inference integration" ok?

Jess: We should avoid implying any specific customer. The dashboard screenshot shows a real org name in the top-right — Omar can confirm if that's PII. :eyes: 

Omar: Can you blur the org name? We require written consent if a live customer asset is used. If it's a demo account, confirm no real PII. Also: partner logo usage needs HelixCloud brand approval for co-branded lockup. I'll ping partner legal.

legal-bot: Legal review requested for thread 1759999999. Please attach screenshot crop + redacted version.

Marie: Attached redacted PNG and the original. Redacted shows blurred name. Alt text updated draft: "Screenshot of a demo dashboard showing Redwood + HelixCloud integration — organization name blurred." Thoughts?

Kai: Looks cleaner. Please replace raw gradient with semi-transparent black overlay (#000000 at 60%). For accessibility alt text should be concise (under 125 chars). Shorten to: "Demo dashboard of Redwood + HelixCloud integration (org name blurred)".

Omar: That alt text is fine. Also HelixCloud requires wordmark-only (no tagline) for co-branded lockup. Send them final PNG with lockup and request written approval. I can send the email template.

Marie: Great. Can you draft the approval ask? Also confirm footnote copy: "HelixCloud logo used with permission."

Jess: Keep footnote short and link to the partner asset agreement. If approval takes longer, we can use generic "Partner logo used with permission" until confirmed.

Omar: I'll draft & send to HelixCloud legal now. ETA ~48h. CC Marie and Kai.

Marie: :thumbsup: Thanks — I'll queue the approved hero for the playbook once we get confirmation.
thread_summary: Discussion about hero image for Integration Playbook with HelixCloud: crop/overlay suggestions, alt text accessibility, blurring customer org name, and partner logo approval process. Legal to request written permission; design to prepare final lockup and accessible alt text.
